scope: Experimental apply pipeline snapshot, not production integration. Adds two cycles per applied pending entry.
design: Capture selected rows/row_bytes, register product next cycle, then execute existing atomic apply/accumulation. Reset, clear, discard and commit_all invalidate phase; payload flops do not reset.
verification: Both simulators pass 90 three-entry transactions spanning all policies, power-of-two and general rings, 32-bit byte widths and independent 64-bit byte oracle. Compare committed tables/counters with old RTL. Cancel each new pre-retirement stage and check no stale commit.
limitations: Directed candidate validation is not full microsequencer/transaction regression. Production RTL unchanged. Existing apply cancellation after partial retirement semantics are not broadened by this test.
next_action: Use completed route to target descriptor admission/commit counter; compare overlap/counter final routes before production selection.

final_route.decision: Do not integrate serial apply candidate yet: setup still fails, area increases and two cycles per entry are added. Compare pending overlap and parallel counter candidates.
